text:
rahul: RFC follow-up: introduce a "deferredRetry" mode for paginated iterators. Idea: don't block the caller on transient failures for the *next* page; schedule bounded background retries instead. Less head-of-line blocking for sync users.

cam: Interesting. Need a clear language/API mapping and strict resource bounds.

rahul: Proposal sketch: default off. When true: 1) fetch page N synchronously; 2) if N+1 fails transiently, schedule a retry worker with bounded queue and backoff; 3) expose iterator.prefetch(depth) and iterator.deferredRetryPolicy(opts) for power users. Example (TS):

```ts
const it = client.listItems({pageSize: 100, deferredRetry: true});
for await (const page of it.pages()) {
  // process page N immediately
}
it.prefetch(2);
it.deferredRetryPolicy({maxAttempts:5, baseBackoffMs:200});
```

tina: Cancellation model is important. If caller stops, background retries should cancel immediately and free buffers. Also surface telemetry: queuedRetries, activeRetries, lastRetryError.

eli: Language constraints: Python sync iterator -> use a single background thread (ThreadPoolExecutor limited to 1 per iterator). Prefer async iterator for more concurrency. Node -> internal async task loop. Go -> goroutine + token bucket per iterator.

sasha: Idempotency: only allow deferredRetry for read-only/idempotent paged endpoints, or when server sets retryHint.safeToRetry=true. Otherwise disabled.

cam: We can add retryHint metadata: { safeToRetry: bool, suggestedBackoffMs: number }. SDKs respect by default, allow override with explicit opt-in.

rahul: Bounded memory: prefetch queue size = depth * pageSize; also cap total bytes and number of in-flight retries. Default depth=1.

eli: Ordering: must guarantee pages are yielded in order. Background tasks only fill immediate gaps (next missing page). No racing ahead.

rahul: Failure semantics: if retries exhaust, iterator should surface a terminal error on subsequent access. Offer onDeferredRetryExhausted hook for custom fallback logic.

cam: Tests: unit tests for cancellation and cleanup, stress test many iterators, e2e flaky network to validate caller latency doesn't regress.

tina: Telemetry & cost: track retry rpc_count, extra_tokens, queued_retry_count. Add DEFERRED_RETRY_VERBOSE env flag for local debug traces.

eli: Python API sketch: client.list_items(..., deferred_retry=True) -> returns iterator obj with .pages() and .close() to cancel background worker.

sasha: Go API sketch:
```go
it := client.ListItems(ctx, opts.WithDeferredRetry(true))
defer it.Close()
for it.Next() {
  pg := it.Page()
}
if err := it.Err(); err != nil { /* handle */ }
```

rahul: Security: don't retry with one-time ephemeral tokens. If auth refresh needed, integrate with auth refresh flow and don't leak creds in logs.

cam: Backcompat: keep disabled mode identical. When enabled, document invariants: 1) no duplicate pages, 2) ordering preserved, 3) best-effort completion for transient errors.

sasha: Implementation note: server should optionally provide retryHint in page responses; SDK treats missing hint as conservative (safeToRetry=false) unless user overrides.

eli: I'll own Python spike + tests. sasha take server-side contract text. tina owns telemetry/profiling. rahul will draft appendix.

ci-bot: deploy-checklist: feature-flag, integration-tests, perf-suite.

cam: OK. Please draft short RFC appendix with per-lang API sketches, bounded semantics, telemetry keys, and server retryHint proto. We'll review and decide spike window. :thumbsup:
